name: dsh-select-assist
description: DSH plugin: a configurable selection toolbar for any Windows app — reorderable skills, custom prompt skills, first N on the bar and the rest in a dropdown, answered in a native always-on-top overlay. · DeepSeek Harness 划词技能栏：技能可增删/拖拽排序，前 N 个常驻浮条、其余收进下拉；内置动作与自定义提示词技能共用一套浮层。
